lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Aao, chai pi lo, thandi ho rahi hai.
lines.gloss_en: Come have some tea, it is getting cold.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Bhaiya, ek khat tha koi...

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Kaunsa khat, Sunita?

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Chhod do abhi, Bhaiya.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Bhaiya, Tau ke samne tum bahut shareef bante ho!
lines.gloss_en: Brother, you act so well-behaved in front of Uncle!

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Kya?

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Tau ne dekha tha tum gire the hastte-hastte!
lines.gloss_en: Uncle saw you fall over laughing!

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Chhod bhi do, Chachi aa rahi hai.
lines.gloss_en: Let it go, Chachi is coming.

lines.speaker: char_chachi
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Yeh sab chhodo, chai peeyo.
lines.gloss_en: Forget all this, drink your tea.

lines.speaker: char_chachi
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Sunita, Tau ne kaha tha ki ghar mein ek khat hai.
lines.gloss_en: Sunita, Uncle had said there is a letter in the house.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Kaun sa khat, Chachi?

lines.speaker: char_chachi
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Woh khat jo kabhi mila nahi...

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Chachi, kuch toh chhupa hai is ghar mein.
lines.gloss_en: Chachi, something is hidden in this house.

lines.speaker: char_chachi
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Beta, kuch baatein khaamoshi mein rehti hain.
lines.gloss_en: Child, some things remain in silence.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Chitthi kahan hai, Bhaiya?

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Main nahi jaanta koi chitthi.
lines.gloss_en: I do not know of any letter.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Tau ne kaha tha tum jaante ho!
lines.gloss_en: Uncle said you know about it!

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Tau galat bol rahe hain.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Main sach jaanna chahti hoon, Bhaiya!
lines.gloss_en: I want to know the truth, Brother!

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Yeh ghar ki baat hai.
lines.gloss_en: This is a matter of the family.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Harmonium ke andar kya rakh diya kisne?
lines.gloss_en: What has someone placed inside the harmonium?

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Ek band lifafa! Yahan chhupa tha!
lines.gloss_en: A sealed envelope! It was hidden here!

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Main zaroor padhungi yeh.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Yeh khat kiska hai?

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Aadhee raat ko kyun uthaya mujhe, Tau?
lines.gloss_en: Why did you wake me at midnight, Uncle?

lines.speaker: char_randhir
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Woh khat kahan hai, Dharam?

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Tau, main...

lines.speaker: char_randhir
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Baarh saal tak chhupaya! Kyun?

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Main padhungi yeh khat.

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Sunita, ruk.

lines.speaker: char_randhir
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Dharam, ab nahi ruk sakta.
lines.gloss_en: Dharam, it cannot be stopped now.

lines.speaker: char_randhir
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Haan... woh sach tha jo usme likha tha.
lines.gloss_en: Yes... what was written in it was the truth.

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Tau... tum mere...

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Sunita...

lines.speaker: char_sunita
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Bhaiya, main maafi maangti hoon.

lines.speaker: char_dharam
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Yeh dard dono ne jhela hai.
lines.gloss_en: We both have borne this pain.

lines.speaker: char_chachi
lines.text: [hi placeholder] Tum dono bahut strong ho.
